title: Claim decisions shard
description: Reviewed decisions for claim rows and files of the claim ledger. A shard is merged onto the inventory in memory by scripts/check-doc-inventory-gates.mjs --decisions; the inventory itself is never rewritten. Enumerated values are not repeated here: a property marked x-vocabulary is checked against that section of claim-and-disposition-vocabulary.json. One shard has one author; one claim has at most one decision across all shards.

shard.description: Shard name, equal to the file name without .json.

sources.description: Repository-relative paths of the source files this shard decides. Every claim of the shard must belong to one of them.

mirrors.description: Script-proven legacy evidence copies; the gate rechecks both committed blobs and expands every source unit.

exact.description: Unit-exact rows independently re-proven against committed units and rebound by digest.

files.description: File-level decisions. They replace the inventory item's proposedDisposition, proposedRationale and proposedTargetOwner (the first entry of targets).

targets.description: Documents that carry the file's claims; the first is the file-level target owner. Empty when the disposition needs no target owner.

registryGaps.description: Dispositions for identity-gap rows that exist only in the identity registry (the unit's old identity could not be paired with a live row). They overlay the registry in memory; no claim row is touched.

sourceUnitDigest.description: A prefix of at least 16 hex characters of the row's sourceUnitDigest; it binds the decision to the exact source text that was judged.

targetOwner.description: The one document that carries the claim; null only when the disposition needs no target owner.

targetAnchor.description: A heading or block anchor of targetOwner (the anchors the conservation extractor yields); null only when targetOwner is null.

remainder.description: For partial-carry: what part of the unit the target does not carry. Mandatory for partial-carry.

targetUnitDigest.description: A prefix (at least 16 hex characters) of the text digest of the target unit at targetAnchor when the reviewer compared it. Required for a reviewed decision with a target; when the unit changes the gate reports target drift and the review no longer holds.

reviewStatus.description: An author writes pending, or blocking for an unknown-blocking row. reviewed is written only after an independent review.

rationale.description: The row's own reason: where the claim went and why, or why it was not carried.

searched.description: Evidence of where the author looked (grep terms and files); mandatory for unknown-blocking and every delete-* disposition.
